# taskdev.dev

TaskDev is a local task runner for developers and AI coding agents.
It provides a VS Code and Windsurf extension plus an MCP server for starting,
stopping, restarting, and inspecting long-running development tasks.

## Website

- [taskdev.dev](https://taskdev.dev)

- [Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Tolbxela.taskdev)
- [Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/tolbxela/taskdev)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tolbxela/taskdev)

## Key facts

- TaskDev runs tasks as local processes on the user's machine.
- Task definitions live in a project-local `taskdev.json` file.
- The editor extension and MCP server share the same task state and logs.
- TaskDev is not a hosted task runner, CI service, or project-management platform.
- The extension does not send telemetry or task logs to TaskDev.
